title: ProtoQA: A Question Answering Dataset for Prototypical Common-Sense Reasoning
reasoning: The paper's goal is to benchmark common-sense reasoning about prototypical situations. While some example questions or answers might incidentally touch upon religious figures or practices (e.g., 'monk', 'pray'), the dataset and evaluation are not designed to specifically assess or benchmark the model's understanding of religion, morals, or ethics. It is not a core component of the work.
